item.text:
ResStock 2025 Release 1 assigns AMY (actual meteorological year) weather **at the county level**, using approximately **1,200 weather stations**.

- A county gets a station within its boundaries if one is available.
- Otherwise, it gets the station closest to its **population centroid**, prioritizing stations in the same climate zone.
- **All housing units in that county use the same assigned weather file.**
- Timestamps are shifted when the selected station is in a different time zone.

The technical guide describes AMY 2018 EPW files, with station locations roughly matching TMY3 locations. The assignment is implemented through `options_lookup.tsv`, which passes the weather-file parameter to `ResStockArguments`. See [the 2025 Release 1 Technical Reference Guide, §8.1.5, p. 52](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=62).
